        return 0

        'type': 'list',
        'children': [],
        'tight': True,
        'bullet': bullet,
        'start': m.start(),
        'end': m.end()
    }

    last_pos = pos
    while pos < len(state.src):

    # Add the token to the state
    state.add_token(token)
